- Key ask: must be idempotent and auditable for refunds. "Do not refund twice" — CTO quote.
- Priorities: reliable tool-calls under spike (Black Friday), deterministic ticket summaries for agents, low-latency action paths for refunds (95p latency target < 400ms for tool calls).

- Cost sensitivity: wants batching + KV prefix caching to reduce per-token spend for high-volume similarity / dedupe flows.
- Integration notes: Zendesk (ticket id mapping), Jira (escalation project TF-OPS), Stripe (sandbox refunds, idempotency_key), Genesys contact center for live agent integration.
- Quote from Head of Ops: "If you can show safe refund automation with audit trail, we can expand to full automation across Returns + Chargebacks."
